exposure: discordant middle cerebral artery peak systolic volume (MCA-PSV)
cohort: Multiple pregnancies referred to NSW Fetal Therapy Centre (FTC) between April 2006 and April 2014, including 14 TAPS cases, 142 TTTS cases, and 45 uncomplicated monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies
finding: Overall mortality for TAPS was similar to that of TTTS but significantly higher compared to uncomplicated MCDA pregnancies.
